note: Every shipped asset and every stated fact gets a row here. Missing field or expired recheck date fails the build. The gate is provenance, not truth: it enforces that a claim has a named source that supports it, not that the claim is correct. Truth is the Research Lead's craft.

assets.description: One flight-call note of a whooper swan (Cygnus cygnus), trimmed from XC803772 (0.80 s, from 36.64 s to 37.44 s of the source), mixed to mono, resampled to 22050 Hz, peak-normalised to -1 dBFS, 20 ms fades at both ends.
